entities.summary: Narzullo Naimovich Oblomuradov is an Uzbekistani politician and scientist who has been serving as the leader of the Ecological Party of Uzbekistan since 1 February 2021. Since 30 December 2021, he has been the Chairman of the State Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan on Ecology and Environmental Protection. He was the Ecological Party's presidential candidate in 2021 presidential elections. He got 4.1%.
